app.notes: Host Setup: going back to an earlier step never touches a running node, and Finished says your node is live only once it is in an epoch. The fee card shows what hosts really paid last epoch while your own estimate is worked out. Monitor/Vote: weights explained by each model's rate, a Weight column for every host, how well each host worked from its AI sessions, and a node in its first epoch says so. Rentals read CUDA 13. Updates no longer cut anyone off: an open copy updates once nothing is running.
